verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṁ paṭipajjanti;
verses.english: … so too the sentient beings who understand the meaning and the teaching and practice in line with the teaching are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṁ na paṭipajjanti.
verses.english: while those who understand the meaning and the teaching but don’t practice in line with the teaching are many.
